engine.rule: the runner refuses any other binary; requests are built from request_template below, not from s3_runner.py

request_template.diagnostics: <diagnostics: false except the declared diagnostic subset>
request_template.opponent: <'alone' for head-to-head levels; the doctrine name for pool fights>

score.S: summary.survivors - summary.enemySurvivors (side 0 = our controlled side), for every completed fight including ordinary game-duration timeouts
score.timeout: a completed fight with summary.t >= 150 - dt/2 and both survivor counts > 0; reported descriptively, scored by S like any fight
score.D: summary.crossTeamDealt[0] - summary.crossTeamTaken[0] (fight-long totals, dead units included); friendly fire reported separately from summary.friendlyDealt[0], friendlyTaken[0]; descriptive only, never a tie-breaker

seeds.derivation: seed(ns, i) = int.from_bytes(sha256(bytes.fromhex(root) + ns.encode('ascii') + i.to_bytes(8,'big')).digest()[:4], 'big'); i is zero-based

namespaces.POOL: i = 0..31 (32 seed blocks), one panel shared by P2 and P3 and by every arm and doctrine

seeds.preflight: before any fight: derive all 232 seeds; if any duplicate within or across namespaces, or any overlap with a development seed (astelia_cpp/S4_SEED_LEDGER.json, astelia_cpp/s4_amended_development/s4_seeds.json, 2026100500-2026100529, 2026100700-2026100729, 101, 102, 301-303, 701-704, 811-813), stop without fighting; the drafter draws a new root and the specification is re-reviewed
seeds.provenance: revision 1's root was retired unused; this root was drawn with revision 2, after the knob sources were fixed by Claude's S4 amended review (commit e12f259)
seeds.fresh_root_rule: if this specification changes after any judging fight has started, the changed specification needs a new root; a started panel is never retried in another directory

HEAD.cluster: (level, i): the mean S of its two orientations; arms joined by (level, i, orientation)

POOL.block: i: one seed for all 19 doctrines x 2 orientations; arms joined by (doctrine, i, orientation); block value = mean over its 38 paired differences

statistics.bound: one-sided t: lower = mean - t_inv(1 - a, n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n); upper = mean + t_inv(1 - a, n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n); sd is the sample SD with denominator n - 1
statistics.zero_variance: if sd = 0 the bounds equal the mean
statistics.assumption: independent clusters/blocks; t calibration is approximate for discrete survivor scores, declared as a limit, not changed after results

alpha.logic: P1 support is an intersection-union of two level tests, each at 1/400; P1 refutation is a union of two level tests at 1/2400 each; P2 and P3 each 1/400 support + 1/1200 refutation; total 3/400 + 3/1200 = 1/100

P1.claim: the resonator (head knobs) beats the scripted level head-to-head for BOTH novice and regular

verdict.SUPPORTED: for both levels: lower bound at a = 1/400 > 0
verdict.REFUTED: for either level: upper bound at a = 1/2400 < 0

P2.claim: the resonator beats plain morale by more than delta on the pool
P2.requires: all 1,216 resonator and 1,216 morale POOL fights VALID (failures.rule)

P3.claim: the resonator beats the specified push-pull baseline by more than delta on the pool
P3.requires: all 1,216 resonator and 1,216 pushpull POOL fights VALID (failures.rule)

delta_survivors.source: S4 amended rule max(1, 0.25 x max pooled validation paired SD), rounded up to 0.5 (POWER_PLANNING.json)

n.P1: 100 clusters per level, fixed conservative choice; B-knob planning (B validation, bootstrap 95th-percentile SD 4.73 novice / 0.77 regular, one-sided 1/400, power 0.90, effect 4.0) gives 24 and 1, below the declared floor 32; bootstrap convention for the displayed SDs: Python random.Random(811005), 2,000 resamples of the 100 cluster values with replacement, statistics.stdev, sorted, element int(0.95*2000)-1
n.P2_P3: 32 seed blocks, above the S4 floor 16

failures.technical_failure: native error line, nonzero exit, timeout of the host, malformed or non-finite summary, duplicate or missing scheduled key
failures.rule: A required fight is VALID only if it completes with a finite summary and with neither the controller_failure predicate nor a technical_failure. Every attempted fight is recorded, valid or not; nothing is dropped, replaced, zero-filled or averaged over a partial cluster or block. If any required fight of an endpoint is invalid or missing, that endpoint is INDETERMINATE with the reason and no bounds are computed for it. Dependencies: P1 requires the 400 HEAD resonator fights; P2 requires the 1,216 POOL resonator and 1,216 POOL morale fights; P3 requires the 1,216 POOL resonator and 1,216 POOL pushpull fights. So a POOL morale failure affects only P2, a POOL pushpull failure only P3, a POOL resonator failure both, and nearest or HEAD descriptive-arm failures affect no endpoint. Every endpoint is evaluated independently; a P1 outcome never stops the POOL panel.

host.batches: one worker batch = one arm and one cluster (HEAD: 2 fights) or one block (POOL: 38 fights); batches never mix arms or panels
host.attribution: a host timeout, nonzero exit or malformed line invalidates every fight of that batch that has not yet returned a valid summary AND every fight of that batch already returned (conservative: it can only produce INDETERMINATE, never a false pass)

execution.order: preflight (identities, gates, seeds), then create the output directory atomically (os.mkdir; refuse if it exists), then write identity.json (spec sha256, root, binary and manifest sha256, authorization record, host timeouts) and schedule.json (every scheduled key and its full native request) before the first dispatch; each request is appended to attempts.jsonl before it is sent, and its summary or failure record to fights.jsonl when it returns; an attempt without a returned record is invalid; HEAD then POOL
execution.latch: the directory is never deleted or reused; an interrupted run is reported as such with partial evidence, never resumed under another directory
execution.outputs: results.json with endpoint_coverage for P1, P2, P3 (evaluated with value, bounds and verdict, or not_run with reason), per-level P1 subtests, descriptive tables; fights.jsonl with every request and summary

descriptive_only.arms: morale, pushpull, nearest on HEAD; nearest on POOL (all scheduled above; 6,464 fights in total)
descriptive_only.diagnostics: resonator, POOL blocks i = 0, 1, 2, all 19 doctrines, orientation false only: the same scheduled fights requested with diagnostics true (design section 7 formulas); 57 fights, no extra fights
descriptive_only.never_used_for: endpoint verdicts, tie-breaking, stopping, or selection
